# canonicalized identity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:canonicalizedIdentity`](gmeow-canonicalizedIdentity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/canonicalizedIdentity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

The current self-asserted agent to which a historical [`AuthorIdentity`](../classes/gmeow-AuthorIdentity.md) is understood to refer. Old and new identities coexist as co-equal standpoints, never merged by identical identity ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
